ITimeSampled

## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Scientific data interfaces
//
// The shared interface of time-indexed collections: how many samples they hold
// and when each zero-based sample was taken.

// The family of time-indexed collections: a sample count and a time for each
// zero-based sample index.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_series)
interface ITimeSampled
    inherits IValue
{
    SampleCount(x: Self): Integer;
    TimeAt(x: Self, index: Integer): Instant;
}
```
